name: Dummy Echo
description: A no-op reference plugin for exercising and demonstrating the plugin system end to end. It brokers nothing real and holds no privilege: its sidecar starts, is reachable only from the networks of the agents it's granted to, and is torn down on uninstall, while its command-line tool simply echoes back whatever arguments you give it. Install and grant it as a safe smoke test — a way to confirm that plugin install, sidecar lifecycle and grant-driven network wiring all work before installing a plugin that holds real credentials or reaches an external system. Agents drive it with the dependency-free `aee-echo` command-line tool (e.g. `aee-echo hello`).
promptLine: You can echo through the dummy broker with `aee-echo` — run `aee-echo --help`.
